title: Ledger Nano X (Specimen A) from Yahoo! Flea Market, Japan

purchase.dateNote: The seller said they had originally bought it on Amazon some time earlier.

components: STMicroelectronics STM32G431KBU6 MCU, markings intact (CHN 551, likely week 51 of 2025)
Flat printed antenna taped across the battery and the LTE module
Unmarked replacement LiPo battery with no protection circuit
Kapton flex soldered to the Nano X test pads (GND, VBAT, display SPI)
implant.notes: A one-piece polyimide (Kapton) flex PCB, with silkscreen designators up to U6, is laminated across the back of the Nano X board. Its plated holes line up with the factory test pads, which give the implant power and the display SPI lines. Some joints only anchor the flex. A tail carries the replacement battery, and the module area carries the MCU, the eSIM and the LTE module in space taken from the shrunken battery.

sources.title: Ledger Nano X: the spy implant
sources.author: Tibane Labs

Fully apart: OLED, unmarked battery with antenna, flex implant, Nano X board.
